en: Color-tinted, aerial-style view of a European town square dominated by a large, two‑storey neoclassical public building with a central pediment and red-tiled roof. Tree-lined streets encircle a rectangular plaza in front of the building. To the right stands a tall, cylindrical brick water-tower-like structure; behind are low industrial buildings with a smoking chimney and a river or large body of water in the distance. Rows of modest townhouses with pitched roofs line both sides of the square.
